page_description: Paste a song, album or podcast link and get it on every other service.
intro: Paste a Spotify or Deezer link: song, album, artist, podcast or episode.
empty_prompt: Nothing pasted yet, try one of these:
error_invalid_link: That does not look like a link. Paste the whole thing, starting with https://
error_unsupported: No supported service recognises that link. Spotify and Deezer links work.
error_not_found: That link points at nothing we could find.
error_unavailable: The music service did not answer. Worth another try in a moment.
error_unexpected: Something went wrong on our side.
